Message:
cgroup: bpf: use cgroup_lock()/cgroup_unlock() wrappers

Replace mutex_[un]lock() with cgroup_[un]lock() wrappers to stay
consistent across cgroup core and other subsystem code, while
operating on the cgroup_mutex.
